text: Various presentations and announcements will be made at the City Council meeting.

Various presentations, introductions and announcements were made to City Council on June 24 and 25, 2026. June 24, 2026 Speaker Nunziata, during the morning session of the meeting, called upon Mayor Chow to deliver remarks in memory of Toronto Police Constable Marc Pinizzotto. Mayor Chow addressed City Council and gave remarks to honour the life and work of the late Constable Pinizzotto, who died in the line of duty on June 11. Mayor Chow extended condolences on behalf of City Council to Constable Pinizzotto’s family and friends, and to members of the Toronto Police Service, and invited Members of Council to observe a moment of silence. Councillor Thompson, during the morning session of the meeting, advised Members of Council that the Taste-of-Lawrence street festival was celebrating its twenty-second year, and introduced a brief video promoting this year’s iteration of the festival.…
